proposed_from.topic: Certified-accuracy fixed-row spectral distributional-discrepancy benchmarks for unequal randomization. For fixed r>=2, integer B in Z^(r x n), rational prescribed treatment probabilities p_i, z in {-1,1}^n with E[z]=2p-1, and OPT=min_D lambda_max(E[B(z-Ez)(z-Ez)'B']), prove exact equivalence between assignment laws and reachable vector-prefix flows preserving every marginal and the terminal covariance. Construct rational epsilon-instance-optimal designs with matching PSD/spectral-Bellman lower certificates in time polynomial in the expanded lattice, input length, and log(1/epsilon); verify supplied algebraic exact certificates, claiming polynomial exact construction only when a polynomial-size projected covariance-hull description is supplied. Extract an optimal sparse law with at most n+r(r+1)/2 atoms, state the sharper attainable-feature-rank bound, preserve the corrected finite-population Horvitz--Thompson factor 1/(4n^2), and build a thin-matrix adapter/benchmark protocol for Rao--Zhang's released pure-balance MWU code. Explicitly credit Altschuler--Boix-Adsera for scalarized structured MOT, Haus for mixability/PARTITION, and standard SDP/ellipsoid machinery; exclude unrestricted exact construction, identity-block robustness, fixed counts, entropy constraints, superpopulation inference, and unexecuted performance claims. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Three fresh presolves derived exact flow/law and covariance preservation, minimax certificates valid at eigenvalue ties, explicit primal and spectral/Bellman feasibility repairs, a polynomial-bit dual box, covariance-preserving support compression, and exact marginal postprocessing for empirical MWU outputs. Exact symbolic checks verified the irrational optimum (67+sqrt(1609))/288 for a rational two-row unequal-margin instance; sixteen flow/Bellman/feature-rank cases and sixty marginal-repair cases passed. Boundary audits covered zero columns, rank deficiency, zero covariance, endpoint propensities, rational-value failure, support off-by-one errors, HT normalization, and projected-hull complexity; current-source checks found no complete-package collision. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Instantiate a concrete rational ellipsoid/truncation theorem and prove that the implementation meets the draft's exact-affine, delta-residual output contract in polynomial expanded-lattice, input-bit, and logarithmic-accuracy time; the conditioning bounds and repair algebra are supplied. EARLY KILL TEST: Execute the four-cell pilot: the irrational witness at certified gap <=2^-12, zero-column marginal preservation, a nondegenerate thin full-row-rank instance through unchanged-source zero padding, and the exact zero-matrix branch; independently verify repaired laws and certificates, stopping or pivoting if any mathematical cell fails or no nondegenerate consumer cell works without substantive source changes. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The nearest experimental-design theorem is RaoZhang2025DDM, Theorem 4.2 with Eq. (6), used here only for its accuracy-dependent upper-only benchmark guarantee under the common normalization. No explicit multiplier or numerical ordering is asserted pending an archived canonical primary-PDF verification. Rao--Zhang's Problem 3.1 already imposes \(\Pr_D(z_i=1)=p_i\), and their Eq. (3) already gives the Horvitz--Thompson covariance/MSE identity, so neither exact population marginals nor that identity is a delta. The nearest transport results are AltschulerBoixAdsera2023StructuredMOT, Theorem 4.1, which proves the polynomial equivalence of \(\mathsf{MOT}\), \(\mathsf{ELLIPSOID}\), and \(\mathsf{MIN}\), and Theorem 4.3, which proves that Algorithm 1 returns an optimal sparse vertex using polynomially many \(\mathsf{ARGMIN}\) calls. The sole field-level novelty claim is the specialized PrefixCert theorem: optimize only \(n+d+1\) assignment-dual coordinates, separate every exponential assignment constraint by an \(O(E_{\mathrm{lat}})\) Bellman recurrence, recover an explicit rational finite-support law and flow from the oracle transcript, repair rational positive-semidefinite residuals, and emit an \(O(E_{\mathrm{lat}}+n+d)\)-entry locally checkable lower certificate paired with an additive interval around the actual instance optimum. This strictly strengthens the available output and certification contract on the fixed-row lattice class without claiming numerical dominance of its upper endpoint. The sparse-support bound, empirical marginal repair, known Horvitz--Thompson bridge, and zero-row padding observation are supporting components rather than standalone novelty claims. The restrictive condition \(\mu=B^{\mathsf T}\theta\), \(\|\theta\|_2\le1\), is maintained only as a low-dimensional causal consumer over prespecified rationalized trial features and is not attributed to Rao--Zhang or included in the design-optimization headline. HenrionNaldiSafeyElDin2021 is explicitly not used to claim generic exact construction: its fixed-size exact SDP theorem does not provide the growing path-flow witness or the claimed certificate size. The first changed proof step and all remaining obligations are enumerated in the rank-one seed and Theorem 3.

proposed_from.literature_map: Rao and Zhang's Problem 3.1 is the exact law-valued unequal-margin spectral objective. Their Theorem 4.1 proves constant-additive hardness with a row dimension of order \(n\), leaving fixed \(r\) open; their Theorem 4.2 gives a polynomial-in-\(1/\varepsilon\) comparison with Bernoulli and Gram--Schmidt-walk guarantees, not \(\mathrm{OPT}+\varepsilon\) or a lower certificate. Their Section 5 supplies the positive-definite trace scalarization and matrix-MWU arc imitated in the setup, while the present proposal must enlarge it to trace-one positive-semidefinite witnesses to cover eigenvalue ties. Altschuler and Boix-Adsera's Theorem 4.1 and Algorithm 1 provide the closest exact-marginal dual-oracle and sparse primal-recovery architecture for one linear multimarginal transport cost; the first unavailable step is the nonlinear spectral minimax with bit-controlled rational feasibility repair. Augustino and coauthors' 2026 exact-marginal completion for approximate multimarginal transport remains exponential in the number of marginals, polynomial in \(1/\varepsilon\), and linear-cost, so it does not close the fixed-row spectral certificate problem. Haus proves pseudopolynomial solvability when the number of rows in complete mixability is fixed and establishes the relevant magnitude dependence, but his scalar bottleneck objective has neither unequal Bernoulli marginals nor a covariance matrix. Harman and coauthors prove rank-sensitive information-matrix-preserving support reduction for approximate designs; consequently the support count here is not positioned as a standalone novelty, and its distinct role is constructive recovery from an implicit prefix-flow law while preserving \(n\) unequal marginals and covariance. Harshaw, Savje, Spielman, and Zhang connect spectral covariance to design-based Horvitz--Thompson risk; the proposal preserves that causal bridge with the algebraically corrected factor \(1/(4n^2)\), without claiming a new limit law. Chatterjee, Dey, and Goswami show that a central limit theorem for Gram--Schmidt walk uses the walk's skeletal martingale structure, confirming that inference cannot be inferred from a sparse optimal law alone. Arbour, Dimmery, Mai, and Rao treat arbitrary-propensity online balancing, while Kulkarni, Reis, and Rothvoss and Aden-Ali treat symmetric online vector discrepancy; neither occupies offline fixed-row certified instance optimality. Watrous's 2009 theorem gives logarithmic-accuracy value approximation under an explicit interior-ball promise but does not output an exact-affine feasible coupling or certificate. The backend must instantiate an equality-aware rational weak-optimization framework with the explicit radii, separation oracles, affine parameterization, and residual repair stated here. No closer source located in searches for fixed-dimensional spectral DDM, covariance multimarginal transport, or exact unequal-margin design certificates subsumes the package.
